uri.description: Resolvable URI of the record at this version (`...@v7`).

version.description: Version of the record after the event.

origin.title: EventOrigin

record.description: Full mode only. The record projection as of delivery preparation, with its `version`.

data.title: CloudEventData

dataschema.description: URI of the catalog schema of this event type.

id.description: The ledger event id. Receivers dedupe on it.

source.description: URI of the company and project the event came from.

subject.description: `urn:tl:<ulid>` of the subject record, the ordering key.

time.description: When the ledger committed the event (UTC).

payload.title: CloudEvent

Workflow.Transitioned.summary: A record moved from one workflow state to another.
Workflow.Transitioned.title: A record moved from one workflow state to another.

WebhookHeaders.description: Standard Webhooks headers that accompany every delivered event.

webhook-id.description: Unique identifier of the delivery, the same across retries.

webhook-signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the id, timestamp and payload, as 'v1,<base64>'.

webhook-timestamp.description: Unix time in seconds at which the delivery was signed.

info.description: Events delivered by Throughline webhooks as CloudEvents 1.0 JSON, signed with Standard Webhooks headers. Generated from the LinkML event classes.
info.title: Throughline events

receiveFeedPosted.summary: A post was made in a project feed.

receiveFeedReacted.summary: A reaction was set or cleared on a post.

receiveFileProcessed.summary: A file passed its scan and is available.

receiveFileRejected.summary: A file failed its scan and was rejected.

receiveFileUploaded.summary: A file was uploaded and attached to a record; it is quarantined until its scan finishes.

receiveLinkAccepted.summary: A suggested link was accepted and is now active.

receiveLinkAdded.summary: A link between two records became active.

receiveLinkDeclined.summary: A suggested link was declined; it will not be suggested again.

receiveLinkFlagged.summary: A link was flagged stale or broken.

receiveLinkRepinned.summary: The pin of a link was set to another revision.

receiveLinkSuggested.summary: A link was suggested and waits for a person to accept or decline.

receiveLinkVerified.summary: A person verified an active link.

receiveNumberingAllocated.summary: A number was allocated from a counter.

receivePsetValuesSet.summary: Values of a property set were written on a record.

receiveRecordCorrected.summary: A recorded value was corrected after the fact; history keeps the original.

receiveRecordUpdated.summary: One or more fields of a record changed.

receiveSchemaEffectiveChanged.summary: The effective schema of a scope changed.

receiveSchemaPackagePublished.summary: A schema package version was published.

receiveWebhookSubscriptionEnabled.summary: A disabled subscription started receiving events again, from this event on.

receiveWebhookSubscriptionSecretRotated.summary: A new signing secret was issued; the previous one keeps signing until the overlap ends.

receiveWebhookSubscriptionUpdated.summary: A subscription's name, target, filter or payload mode changed.

receiveWorkflowTransitioned.summary: A record moved from one workflow state to another.
